height.$description: The height of a control at rest: a density of 1 is the designed 40px, and the computed height is floored at {size.target-min}, an absolute floor that neither the density nor a brand's base can move.

disabled-opacity.$description: How much every control fades when it cannot be used. No control invents its own factor: this one name is the default, and a component that needs a different seam declares a hook over it.
